main_text.p: Medium.Medium olfactus est aër & aqua. In aë-re olfaciunt animalia sanguine prædita, tum exanguia in aëre degentia, tum aquatilia pulmonem habentia. Hoc fit inspirando aërem per pulmones.
Infecta quæ non respirant absque attrac-tione aëris odorantur.
In aqua aquatilia & pulmone caren-tia olfaciunt.
main_text.head: CAPUT XXIII. DE SENSIBUS INTERIORIBUS; ITEM DE Somno.
main_text.p: ADhuc de Exterioribus sensibus; Sequùtur Interiores, qui species rerum sensilium ab Exterioribus allatas in cerebro percipiunt.

p.i: Hi sensilia intra cerebrum recipiendo percipiunt. Hi intra cranium in cerebro sua munia exsequuntur, nec organum extra se positum habent.
Objecta horum sunt sensilia non modò præsentia, sed etiam absentia, verùm quæ antea in sensibus plerumq; fuerant.

main_text.p: Interiores sensus sunt duplices: Cogno-scentes, & conservantes. Sensus interiores.

page.notes: Show-through from the reverse side (faint words in the margins and between the lines, such as "SENSUS", "COMMUNIS" and similar) is left out. The woodcut initial is read as A, and the word after it as Dhuc, so the word is given as ADhuc. Italic and roman boundaries in the last paragraph are read from the scan and may be slightly off. The bottom-right catchword is read as "Cogno-".
